deviations.text: Implementation note, not a protocol deviation: the first Stage-0 /key call used urllib's default User-Agent, which the run's proxy refuses (HTTP 403); it was read as 'remaining 0' and logged D-budget by mistake. Fixed (explicit User-Agent) and Stage 0 re-run; D-budget does not apply (remaining 13.71).

qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507 is served only by Venice at USD 3.5 per million output tokens (smoke: USD 0.0023 for 614 tokens; about USD 0.03 per thinking row, 5x the planned 0.006). Its scale cells are dropped before commit #1a; the scale check runs on gpt-oss-120b (reasoning effort medium) only, if the budget allows after E.

Plan COMMIT #1 is made as two hash-chained commits, each before the rows it governs: #1a (prompts, cells, seeds, N, decoding, budget, lexical rules, mappings, decision-list semantics/thresholds, predictions) before any new sample; #1b (tracer code, probes, planted controls, gate result, rotated sets, N3-D descriptions, analysis code) before the first traced ban row and before the B/C/D/F-ban samples. Reason: thinking rows take 5-7 min each at ~29 tok/s, so A/E sampling must start while the tracer is gated. New rows are not opened, labelled or traced before #1b.

Tracer gate round 0 (references 14/15 with BIDIR-heuristic the one unverified class, planted controls 9/9) failed on gold (163/249 = 0.65). Diagnosis on the gold programs: implementation defects relative to the committed definitions, not class semantics. (i) Recursive searches that carry the path as an argument (dfs(depth, path, visited)) never surfaced the root, and backtracking removals (visited.remove, path.pop) were confirmed as frontier pops. (ii) p_lifo counted every re-expansion as non-LIFO, so the plan's own DFS-revisit class (exhaustive backtracking) was unreachable. Round-1 fixes: a CALL cell can come from a path argument (its last cell); int pairs count as cells only under coordinate-like parameter names; a probe with >= 3 self-recursive cell calls uses the call stream; p_lifo uses a simulated path stack (descend or backtrack-then-descend), excluding immediate reversals. References and planted controls are unchanged by the fixes (14/15, 9/9). Round 0 is kept in results/tracer_gate_round0_final.json.

Tracer gate round 1 (refs 14/15, controls 9/9) left gold at 162/248 = 0.65. Round-2 (the last allowed) diagnosis on gold: (i) queue/stack items of the form (r, c, path) or (r, c, prev_dir, path) lost their cell because only trailing int pairs were read -> leading int pairs are read for non-heap items; (ii) c_f/c_h were trivially 1 whenever the open list held one cell (recursive DFS with goal-sorted neighbours read as HEUR) -> a step counts only when the open list offers >= 2 cells; (iii) exponential IDDFS/IDA* programs hitting the 2 s probe timeout were counted as crashes although their partial traces show the pass structure -> only exceptions count toward the > 20-crash rule, timed-out probes keep their flagged partial record and drop their incomplete last pass from the bound test. References and controls unchanged (14/15, 9/9).

The tracer gate FAILED after the 2 allowed revision rounds: references 14/15 (BIDIR-heuristic unverified), planted controls 9/9, gold 182/260 = 0.70 < 0.90 (per label: bfs 39/40, bibfs 19/20, gbfs 35/35, dijkstra_unit 35/39, dfs 34/39, astar 18/24, jps 1/7, iddfs 0/34, idastar 1/22). Committed fallback (plan): N1-N3 are DESCRIPTIVE; the mechanism label is the iteration-8 10-class name-free runtime label mapped through the 1.11 coarse table (runtime_class); the tracer v9 order class is reported as a second column (sensitivity) with its per-class gate rates. N5 keeps its tracer-based distances and is flagged. Decided before commit #1b and before any ban row was traced.

The committed USD 3.5 cap was budgeted as sampling plus about 0.4 of judges. The iteration-8 adjudication protocol (deepseek-chat-v3.1 + kimi-k2, mistral-medium-3.1 third) cost about USD 0.08 per labelled cell (kimi-k2 rationales), USD 1.02 for the first 13 cells, i.e. 2.5x the plan. To label ALL cells with one consistent protocol (a cheaper judge pair for the last 6 cells would confound N5 and N3-D), the artifact cap is raised from 3.5 to 4.0 at USD 3.21 spent, before labelling B_R1-R3, C_desc, D_R5, D_R6. Sampling had already finished inside 3.5; the phase pot had USD 11.9 left and the system's per-artifact ceiling is USD 10.
7 of 280 B/C/D rows were lost to upstream HTTP 429 rate limits after 4 retries each and were not resampled (time and cap): B_R1 49, B_R2 46, B_R3 48 rows instead of 50; every other cell has 50.

Manual reads cover every Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-14B k=5 and held-out survivor (76 programs; plan TIME-BINDS branch: 'Lower manual reads to k = 5 survivors only'); the survivors whose name-level label and order class disagree at k=1..4 and the 10% sample of other survivors were not read.

L2 was validated on 60 alias-bearing code lines (comments, docstrings, identifiers) from non-ban rows instead of 60 baseline comment lines: baseline programs carry almost no comments (63/729 contain any alias). All 60 are self-naming, so only recall is estimable (0.88); L2's handling of disavowals is checked on the 11 constructed disavowal unit tests (11/11).

queries.query: denial prompting NeoCoder creativity code generation NAACL 2025
Compact Constraint Encoding for LLM Code Generation implementation priors counter-intuitive constraints
The Invisible Lottery subtle cues steer algorithm choice LLM code generation
Semantic Gravity Wells language models negative constraints
white bear effect language models instructed not to mention
IFEvalCode controlled code generation instruction following naming constraints
specification gaming constraint circumvention code language models renaming banned

items.title: Benchmarking Language Model Creativity: A Case Study on Code Generation (NeoCoder; denial prompting; NAACL 2025)
items.quote: We introduce DENIAL PROMPTING which pushes LLMs to develop more creative solutions to a given problem by incrementally imposing new constraints on the previous solution, compelling LLMs to adopt new strategies.
items.relation: technique-level bans to elicit new strategies, scored behaviourally; no execution-order check of whether a banned technique returns under a new name

items.title: Compact Constraint Encoding for LLM Code Generation (Tang 2026)
items.quote: counter-intuitive constraints opposing model defaults fail at 10--100%, while conventional constraints achieve 99%+ compliance regardless of encoding.
items.relation: rule-based constraint compliance by constraint type (implementation priors); not mechanism-level vs name-level compliance

items.title: The Invisible Lottery: How Subtle Cues Steer Algorithm Choice in LLM Code Generation
items.quote: Incidental prompt cues, meaning contextual words or metadata outside the task specification, can steer which algorithm the model selects, even when all outputs pass the same tests.
items.relation: algorithm-family shifts under incidental cues; no prohibitions, no runtime expansion-order audit

items.title: Semantic Gravity Wells: Why Negative Constraints Backfire
items.quote: Negative constraints (instructions of the form "do not use word X") represent a fundamental test of instruction-following capability in large language models. Despite their apparent simplicity, these constraints fail with striking regularity
items.relation: word-level negative constraints and their internal suppression; ours are algorithm-level bans where the WORD can be avoided while the mechanism returns

items.title: Don't Think of the White Bear: Ironic Negation in Transformer Models Under Cognitive Load
items.quote: suppressing a concept requires internally activating it, which may prime rebound instead of avoidance.
items.relation: ironic rebound of a negated concept in text; ours measures rebound of a negated ALGORITHM in executed behaviour

items.title: IFEvalCode: Controlled Code Generation
items.quote: IFEvalCode decouples evaluation into two metrics: correctness (Corr.) and instruction-following (Instr.)
items.relation: programmatic checkers for code constraints incl. naming; a name checker cannot see a renamed mechanism, which is what the tracer adds

items.title: (query 7: specification gaming / renaming in code models)
items.relation: no scholarly or general hit studied lexical vs mechanistic compliance with algorithm bans; top hits were safety-bypass and peer-review gaming papers (results/positioning_raw/q7_*.txt)

tracer_rules.events: ONE global event stream with a sequence counter: POP(cell, kind, container) from the heapq proxy, queue.get, and an AST rewrite of method calls named pop/popleft/remove/discard/popitem on any object; PUSH(cell) from append/appendleft/add/put/insert/extend/extendleft (AST), heappush/heapify (proxy), deque constructor items, and item assignment of a cell key (dict[cell] = v, a[r][c] = v); ITER(cell) for items yielded by for-loops/comprehensions over a container that was pushed to or that holds start/goal; READ(cell) from str-subclass grid rows; CALL(fn, cell) for candidate-frame calls whose arguments contain an in-grid cell (2-int tuple/list or two consecutive ints)
tracer_rules.expansion_record: a candidate is a POP/ITER or CALL carrying a cell (consecutive candidates on the same cell merge); it is CONFIRMED if, before the next candidate, a READ or PUSH touches a 4-neighbour of the cell, or the next candidate is a 4-neighbour of it. E = confirmed container candidates (POP/ITER) if >= 3 on the probe, else confirmed CALL candidates if >= 3, else centres of READ bursts (flagged scan-derived). Restarts are counted on the merged stream.
probe_stats: n_restart, per-pass max d_root and max d_root+h
c_g, c_f, c_h (next expansion in argmin over the open list F of d, d+h, h; ties allowed)
fifo (>= 0.98 of within-level pairs ordered as their discovering parents)
decision_list: (1) ID if root restarts with a growing pass bound on >= 50% of informative probes (fine: ID-depth if the pass max d_root grows by 1, else ID-f)
(2) BIDIR if bidir on >= 50% (fine BIDIR-BFS / BIDIR-heuristic)
(3) BFS if pooled p_mono >= 0.98 AND pooled level_cover >= 0.98 AND no restarts
(4) HEUR if median rho_h >= 0.6 AND max(c_f, c_h) >= 0.9 (fine HEUR-f if c_f >= c_h, HEUR-h, HEUR-jump if jump share >= 0.5)
(5) DFS if pooled p_lifo >= 0.9 (fine DFS-revisit when revisits > 0.1)
tracer_rules.informative_probe: |E| >= 6; >= 10 informative probes per program, else UNTRACEABLE
tracer_rules.revisable_in_gate: at most 2 revision rounds using ONLY references, planted controls and gold: the informative-probe minimum (10 down to 6), the c_f/c_h cut-off and the level_cover cut-off; the class semantics never change

from random import shuffle

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    n_rows = len(grid)
    n_cols = len(grid[0])
    directions = [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]
    queue = [(start, [start])]
    good_positions = [(r, c) for r in range(n_rows) for c in range(n_cols) if grid[r][c] == '.']

    while queue:
        (x, path) = queue.pop()
        a, b = neighbors((n_rows, n_cols), x)
        shuffle(a)
        shuffle(b)
        r_answer = [x]
        for(dx, dy) in zip(a, b):
            nx, ny = x[0] + dx, x[1] + dy
            if (nx, ny) == goal:
                return [i for i in path + [(nx, ny)] if i in good_positions]
            elif (nx, ny) in good_positions:
                r_answer = [i for i in r_answer + [(nx, ny)] if i in good_positions]
                queue.insert(0, ((nx, ny), r_answer))

    return []

def neighbors(size, position):
    (r, c) = position
    n_rows, _ = size
    return [(r0, c) for r0 in [r-1, r+1] if 0 <= r0 < n_rows] + [(r, c0) for c0 in [c-1, c+1] if 0 <= c < size[1]]

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#': return []
    if start == goal: return [start]
    visited = set()
    frontier = deque([(start, [start])])
    while frontier:
        (position, path) = frontier.popleft()
        if position == goal: return path
        for (dr, dc) in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            r, c = position[0]+dr, position[1]+dc
            if (0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0]) and
                grid[r][c] == '.' and (r,c) not in visited):
                frontier.append(((r,c), path + [(r,c)])
                visited.add((r,c))
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])

        path = [list(start)]

        visited = set([tuple(path[-1)])
        while queue:

            if (r, c) == goal:
                while path[-1] != (r, c):
                    path.append((r, c))

                path.reverse()

IDSRow = 1 << 0
IDSCol = 1 << 1
Extendup = 0 << 2
Extenddown = 1 << 2
Extendleft = 0 << 3
Extendright = 1 << 3

def isvalidcell(r, c, grid):
    return 0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0]) and grid[r][c] == '.'

def extend(grid, start: (int, int), goal: (int, int), extensions: [(int, int)]) -> [(int, int)]:
    history = len(extensions)
    extensions.append({})

    if start == goal:
        extensions[history].update({start: '-'})
        return [goal]

    empty = not extensions[history]
    queue = [(start, 0)]
    visited = set()
    while queue:
        ((r, c), depth) = queue.pop(0)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            extensions[history].update({r: {c: {'path': [(r, c)], 'extension': depth}}})
            return extensions[history]
        elif r > 0 and isvalidcell(r - 1, c, grid) and (r - 1, c) not in visited:
            queue.append(((r - 1, c), depth + 1))
            visited.add((r - 1, c))
        elif r < len(grid) - 1 and isvalidcell(r + 1, c, grid) and (r + 1, c) not in visited:
            queue.append(((r + 1, c), depth + 1))
            visited.add((r + 1, c))
        elif c > 0 and isvalidcell(r, c - 1, grid) and (r, c - 1) not in visited:
            queue.append(((r, c - 1), depth + 1))
            visited.add((r, c - 1))
        elif c < len(grid[0]) - 1 and isvalidcell(r, c + 1, grid) and (r, c + 1) not in visited:
            queue.append(((r, c + 1), depth + 1))
            visited.add((r, c + 1))
    return []

def navigate(grid, start, goal):
    extensions = [{}]
    (r, c) = start
    extensions[0][r] = {c: {})
    while extensions[-1]:
        last = len(extensions) - 1
        if last:
            extensions.append({})
        for parent in list(extensions[last]):
            for parentc in list(extensions[last][parent]):
                r, c = parent, parentc
                extensions.append({r: {c: extensions[last][parent][parentc].copy()}})
                up = r - 1
                extensions[last][parent][parentc].update({(up, c): IDSRow | (Extendup << last)})
                down = r + 1
                extensions[last][parent].update({(down, c): IDSRow | (Extenddown << last)})
                left = r
                extensions[last].update({(r, left): IDSCol | (Extendleft << last)})
                right = c + 1
                extensions[last][parent].update({(r, right): IDSCol | (Extendright << last)})
                extensions[-1] = extensions[-1].copy()
                for ch in extensions[-1]:
                    for otherc in extensions[-1][ch]:
                        flips = extensions[-1][ch][otherc] & ((1 << last) - 1)
                        if flips == 0:
                            wo = extensions[last].pop(ch).pop(otherc)
                            if len(extensions[last]) < 2:
                                extensions[last][ch] = {}
                            extensions[last][ch].update(wo)
                            extensions[-2].setdefault(tuple(ch), {}).setdefault(tuple(otherc), 0)
                            extensions[-2][ch][otherc] = extensions[-2][ch][otherc] | (flips << last)
    path = {}
    r = goal[0]
    c = goal[1]
    extensions[-1].setdefault(r, {}).setdefault(c, 0)
    while extensions and (r, c) != start:
        extension = extensions.pop()
        c = min((ch for ch in extension.keys() if extension[ch].get(c, 0) & 2) or [])
        c = min((otherc for otherch in extension for otherc in extension[otherch] if otherc != c and (extension[otherch][otherc] >> len(extensions)) & 1), default=None)
        if c is None:
            return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if (start[0] < 0 or start[0] >= rows or start[1] < 0 or start[1] >= cols or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or
        goal[0] < 0 or goal[0] >= rows or goal[1] < 0 or goal[1] >= cols or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    
    visited = set()
    path = []
    
    def backtrack(current, path):
        if current == goal:
            return True
        visited.add(current)
        directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and
                grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited):
                path.append((nr, nc))
                if backtrack((nr, nc), path):
                    return True
                path.pop()
        visited.remove(current)
        return False
    
    path.append(start)
    if backtrack(start, path):
        return path
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    if (start[0] < 0 or start[0] >= rows or start[1] < 0 or start[1] >= cols or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal[0] < 0 or goal[0] >= rows or goal[1] < 0 or goal[1] >= cols or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    pq = [(0, start[0], start[1])]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    visited = set()
    prev = {}
    while pq:
        dist, row, col = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if (row, col) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((row, col))
        if (row, col) == goal:
            path = [(row, col)]
            current = (row, col)
            while current != start:
                current = prev[current]
                path.append(current)
            return path[::-1]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = row + dr, col + dc
            if 0 <= new_row < rows and 0 <= new_col < cols:
                if grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and (new_row, new_col) not in visited:
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (dist + 1, new_row, new_col))
                    prev[(new_row, new_col)] = (row, col)
    return []

import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0])) or grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0])) or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    
    path = [start]
    visited = set()
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
    
    def backtrack(pos):
        r, c = pos
        if pos == goal:
            return True
        for _ in directions:
            dr, dc = directions[random.randint(0, 3)]
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            next_pos = (nr, nc)
            if (0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and 
                grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_pos not in visited):
                visited.add(next_pos)
                path.append(next_pos)
                if backtrack(next_pos):
                    return True
                path.pop()
        return False
    
    visited.add(start)
    if backtrack(start):
        return path
    return []

                queue.put((nr, nc))

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    if (start[0] < 0 or start[0] >= rows or start[1] < 0 or start[1] >= cols or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal[0] < 0 or goal[0] >= rows or goal[1] < 0 or goal[1] >= cols or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []

    queue = [(0, start)]  # Using uniform-cost search (BFS-like), but not BFS
    visited = {start}
    parent = {}

    while queue:
        cost, current = heapq.heappop(queue)

        if current == goal:
            break

        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
            nr, nc = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and
                grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited):
                visited.add((nr, nc))
                parent[(nr, nc)] = current
                heapq.heappush(queue, (cost + 1, (nr, nc)))

    if goal not in parent:
        return []

    path = [goal]
    while path[-1] != start:
        path.append(parent[path[-1]])
    path.reverse()

    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if (
        not grid or
        not 0 <= start[0] < len(grid) or
        not 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0]) or
        not 0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) or
        not 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0]) or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'
    ):
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    visited = [[False] * cols for _ in range(rows)]

    # Use a priority queue with a dummy cost (0 for any path)
    heap = [(0, start, [start])]
    visited[start[0]][start[1]] = True

    while heap:
        cost, current, path = heapq.heappop(heap)
        r, c = current

        if current == goal:
            return path

        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if (
                0 <= nr < rows and
                0 <= nc < cols and
                not visited[nr][nc] and
                grid[nr][nc] == '.'
            ):
                visited[nr][nc] = True
                new_path = path + [(nr, nc)]
                heapq.heappush(heap, (len(new_path), (nr, nc), new_path))

    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    priority = 0
    count = 0
    pq = []  # priority queue
    heapq.heappush(pq, (0, count, start))

    visited = set([start])
    prev = {}

    while pq:
        _, _, current = heapq.heappop(pq)

        if current == goal:
            path = []
            while current in prev:
                path.append(current)
                current = prev[current]
            path.append(start)
            return path[::-1]

        directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                new_cell = (nr, nc)
                if new_cell not in visited:
                    visited.add(new_cell)
                    prev[new_cell] = current
                    count += 1
                    # All weights are 1, but using uniform cost therapy
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (1, count, new_cell))
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0]) and grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.'):
        return []
    
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0]) and grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '.'):
        return []

    visited = set()
    queue = [(0, start, [start])]

    while queue:
        _, (row, col), path = heapq.heappop(queue)
        
        if (row, col) == goal:
            return path
        
        if (row, col) in visited:
            continue
        
        visited.add((row, col))
        
        neighbors = [
            (row - 1, col),  # up
            (row + 1, col),  # down
            (row, col - 1),  # left
            (row, col + 1)   # right
        ]
        
        for n_row, n_col in neighbors:
            if (0 <= n_row < len(grid) and 0 <= n_col < len(grid[0]) and
                grid[n_row][n_col] == '.' and (n_row, n_col) not in visited):
                new_path = path + [(n_row, n_col)]
                # Randomly choose a heuristic to avoid common search algorithms
                # Using manhattan + a small random number to break ties
                import random
                heur = abs(n_row - goal[0]) + abs(n_col - goal[1]) + random.random()
                heapq.heappush(queue, (heur, (n_row, n_col), new_path))
    
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):

        return [start]

        return []

    path = []

    def dfs(current):
        if current == goal:
            return True
        visited.add(current)
        path.append(current)
        directions = [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]
        random.shuffle(directions)  # Randomize directions to avoid patterned behavior
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                if dfs((nr, nc)):
                    return True
        path.pop()
        return False

    if dfs(start):
        path.append(goal)
        return path
    return []

import sys
from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    if (not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.')) or \
       (not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols and grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '.')):
        return []

    parent = {}
    queue = deque()
    queue.append(start)
    visited = set()
    visited.add(start)

    dr = [-1, 1, 0, 0]
    dc = [0, 0, -1, 1]

    while queue:
        curr = queue.popleft()
        if curr == goal:
            path = []
            while curr:
                path.append(curr)
                curr = parent.get(curr)
            return path[::-1]
        for i in range(4):
            nr, nc = curr[0] + dr[i], curr[1] + dc[i]
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                visited.add((nr, nc))
                parent[(nr, nc)] = curr
                queue.append((nr, nc))

    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    s_row, s_col = start
    g_row, g_col = goal
    if (s_row < 0 or s_row >= rows or s_col < 0 or s_col >= cols or
        g_row < 0 or g_row >= rows or g_col < 0 or g_col >= cols):
        return []
    if grid[s_row][s_col] == '#' or grid[g_row][g_col] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    visited = set([start])
    path = [start]
    
    def backtrack(current):
        if current == goal:
            return True
        for dr, dc in directions:
            next_row = current[0] + dr
            next_col = current[1] + dc
            next_cell = (next_row, next_col)
            if (0 <= next_row < rows and 0 <= next_col < cols and
                grid[next_row][next_col] == '.' and next_cell not in visited):
                visited.add(next_cell)
                path.append(next_cell)
                if backtrack(next_cell):
                    return True
                path.pop()
                visited.remove(next_cell)
        return False
    
    if backtrack(start):
        return path
    else:
        return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    visited = set()
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (start[0] + start[1], start[0], start[1]))
    visited.add((start[0], start[1]))
    predecessors = {(start[0], start[1]): None}
    found = False
    goal_node = None
    
    while heap:
        priority, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        current = (r, c)
        if current == goal:
            found = True
            goal_node = current
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nr, nc))
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (nr + nc, nr, nc))
                    predecessors[(nr, nc)] = current
    
    if not found:
        return []
    
    path = []
    current = goal_node
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = predecessors[current]
    path.reverse()
    return path

import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    # Initialize path and visited set
    path = [start]
    visited = set(path)
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]  # right, down, left, up
    
    while path:
        current = path[-1]
        if current == goal:
            return path
        # Randomize direction order to avoid systematic DFS
        random.shuffle(directions)
        found = False
        for dx, dy in directions:
            x, y = current[0] + dx, current[1] + dy
            next_cell = (x, y)
            if (0 <= x < rows and 0 <= y < cols and
                grid[x][y] == '.' and next_cell not in visited):
                path.append(next_cell)
                visited.add(next_cell)
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            path.pop()
            visited.remove(current)
    return []

Task: write a Python function solve(grid, start, goal) that finds a path between two cells of a grid. grid is a list of equal-length strings with between 1 and 30 rows and between 1 and 30 columns; the character . is a free cell and the character # is a wall. start and goal are (row, col) tuples of 0-based indices. A move goes to one of the 4 orthogonal neighbours (up, down, left, right) and may not leave the grid or enter a wall. Return a list of (row, col) tuples that begins with start, ends with goal, and in which consecutive cells are neighbours and every cell is free. Any valid path is accepted; it does not have to be the shortest. If start equals goal and the cell is free, return [start]. If no path exists, or start or goal is a wall, return [].

examples.output:
import heapq
import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if not rows:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])

    # Check if start or goal is a wall or out of bounds
    for pos in [start, goal]:
        if not (0 <= pos[0] < rows and 0 <= pos[1] < cols) or grid[pos[0]][pos[1]] == '#':
            return []

    # If start is the same as goal and is a free cell
    if start == goal and grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.':
        return [start]

    # Movement directions: up, right, down, left
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]

    # Priority queue (priority, (row, col))
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (random.random(), start))

    # Parent map for path reconstruction
    parent = {}

    # Visited set to avoid cycles and repeated visits
    visited = set([start])

    while pq:
        current = heapq.heappop(pq)[1]

        if current == goal:
            # Reconstruct path
            path = []
            while current:
                path.append(current)
                current = parent.get(current)
            return path[::-1]

        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            next_cell = (nr, nc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_cell not in visited:
                    visited.add(next_cell)
                    parent[next_cell] = current
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (random.random(), next_cell))

    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    if (not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols) or
        not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols)):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    INF = float('inf')
    distance = [[INF] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    pred = [[None] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    sr, sc = start
    distance[sr][sc] = 0
    
    for _ in range(rows * cols - 1):
        updated = False
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(cols):
                if grid[r][c] == '#':
                    continue
                current_dist = distance[r][c]
                if current_dist == INF:
                    continue
                for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and
                        grid[nr][nc] != '#' and
                        distance[nr][nc] > current_dist + 1):
                        distance[nr][nc] = current_dist + 1
                        pred[nr][nc] = (r, c)
                        updated = True
        if not updated:
            break
    
    gr, gc = goal
    if distance[gr][gc] == INF:
        return []
    
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        cr, cc = current
        current = pred[cr][cc]
    path.reverse()
    return path if path[0] == start else []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':

                visited.add(next_pos)
                moved = True
                break

    return []

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start] if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.' else []
    
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    
    visited = set()
    prev = {}
    q = deque()
    
    visited.add(start)
    q.append(start)
    
    found = False
    
    while q:
        current = q.popleft()
        current_row, current_col = current
        
        if current == goal:
            found = True
            break
        
        first = True
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]:
            nr = current_row + dr
            nc = current_col + dc
            next_node = (nr, nc)
            
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_node not in visited:
                    visited.add(next_node)
                    prev[next_node] = current
                    if first:
                        q.appendleft(next_node)
                    else:
                        q.append(next_node)
                    first = False
    
    if not found:
        return []
    
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current != start:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current]
    path.append(start)
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (start[0] + start[1], start, [start]))
    visited.add(start)
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    while heap:
        _, current, path = heapq.heappop(heap)
        r, c = current
        if current == goal:
            return path
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                next_cell = (nr, nc)
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_cell not in visited:
                    visited.add(next_cell)
                    new_path = path + [next_cell]
                    priority = nr + nc
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (priority, next_cell, new_path))
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    if (not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols) or
        not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols) or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    from collections import deque
    visited = set([start])
    prev = {}
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    q = deque([start])
    found = False
    while q:
        current = q.popleft()
        if current == goal:
            found = True
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if (0 <= new_row < rows and 0 <= new_col < cols and
                grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and (new_row, new_col) not in visited):
                visited.add((new_row, new_col))
                prev[(new_row, new_col)] = current
                if dr != 0:
                    q.appendleft((new_row, new_col))
                else:
                    q.append((new_row, new_col))
    if not found:
        return []
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current != start:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current]
    path.append(start)
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    
    if (start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or start_col >= cols or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or goal_col >= cols or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0, start_row, start_col))
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    visited[start_row][start_col] = True
    prev = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    found = False
    while heap:
        dist, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        
        if (r, c) == goal:
            found = True
            break
        
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = r + dr
            nc = c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if not visited[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                    visited[nr][nc] = True
                    prev[nr][nc] = (r, c)
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (dist + 1, nr, nc))
    
    if not found:
        return []
    
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()
    return path

import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    
    parent = {}
    visited = set()
    queue = [start]
    parent[start] = None
    visited.add(start)
    
    while queue:
        current = queue.pop(random.randint(0, len(queue)-1))
        if current == goal:
            path = []
            node = current
            while node is not None:
                path.append(node)
                node = parent[node]
            return path[::-1]
        
        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                visited.add((nr, nc))
                parent[(nr, nc)] = current
                queue.append((nr, nc))
    
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (start[0] + start[1], start[0], start[1]))
    visited = set([start])
    predecessors = {}
    
    while pq:
        _, row, col = heapq.heappop(pq)
        current = (row, col)
        
        if current == goal:
            path = []
            while current != start:
                path.append(current)
                current = predecessors[current]
            path.append(start)
            return path[::-1]
        
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = row + dr, col + dc
            new_pos = (new_row, new_col)
            if (0 <= new_row < len(grid) and 0 <= new_col < len(grid[0]) and
                grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and new_pos not in visited):
                visited.add(new_pos)
                predecessors[new_pos] = (row, col)
                heapq.heappush(pq, (new_row + new_col, new_row, new_col))
    
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not grid:
        return []

    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    def is_valid(row, col):
        return 0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols and grid[row][col] == '.'

    if not is_valid(start[0], start[1]) or not is_valid(goal[0], goal[1]):

    if start == goal and is_valid(start[0], start[1]):
        return [start]

    visited = set()
    path = []

    def find_path(row, col):
        if (row, col) == goal:

            return True

        if not is_valid(row, col) or (row, col) in visited:
            return False

        visited.add((row, col))
        path.append((row, col))

        # Explore neighbors
        if find_path(row - 1, col):  # Up
            return True
        if find_path(row + 1, col):  # Down
            return True
        if find_path(row, col - 1):  # Left
            return True
        if find_path(row, col + 1):  # Right
            return True

        path.pop()  # Backtrack
        return False

    if find_path(start[0], start[1]):
        return path
    else:
        return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not grid:
        return []

    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.'):
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols and grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '.'):
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    visited = set()
    queue = [(start, [start])]
    visited.add(start)

    while queue:
        (row, col), path = queue.pop(0)

        neighbors = [(row - 1, col), (row + 1, col), (row, col - 1), (row, col + 1)]

        for neighbor_row, neighbor_col in neighbors:
            if (0 <= neighbor_row < rows and 0 <= neighbor_col < cols and
                    grid[neighbor_row][neighbor_col] == '.' and
                    (neighbor_row, neighbor_col) not in visited):
                
                new_path = path + [(neighbor_row, neighbor_col)]
                if (neighbor_row, neighbor_col) == goal:
                    return new_path
                
                queue.append(((neighbor_row, neighbor_col), new_path))
                visited.add((neighbor_row, neighbor_col))

    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    from queue import Queue

    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    directions = [(0,1), (1, 0), (0,-1), (-1, 0)]
    q = Queue()
    q.put((start, [start]))
    visited = set()
    visited.add(start)

    while not q.empty():
        current, path = q.get()

        for direction in directions:
            new_row = current[0] + direction[0]
            new_col = current[1] + direction[1]
            new_pos = (new_row, new_col)

            if (0<= new_row < len(grid) and 0<= new_col < len(grid[0]) and
                grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and new_pos not in visited):
                visited.add(new_pos)
                new_path = path + [new_pos]
                if new_pos == goal:
                    return new_path
                q.put((new_pos, new_path))

    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check if start or goal is a wall or out of bounds
    if (start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or start_col >= cols or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#' or
        goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or goal_col >= cols or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []

    # If start is the same as goal
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    # Directions: up, down, left, right
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]

    # Use a stack for DFS
    stack = [(start_row, start_col, [start])]
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start_row, start_col))

    while stack:
        row, col, path = stack.pop()
        for dr, dc in directions:
            r, c = row + dr, col + dc
            if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and grid[r][c] == '.' and (r, c) not in visited:
                if (r, c) == (goal_row, goal_col):
                    return path + [(r, c)]
                visited.add((r, c))
                stack.append((r, c, path + [(r, c)]))

    return []

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols):
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    queue = deque()
    queue.append(start)
    visited[start[0]][start[1]] = True
    
    while queue:
        current = queue.popleft()
        row, col = current
        
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
            nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and not visited[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                visited[nr][nc] = True
                parent[nr][nc] = current
                queue.append((nr, nc))
                if (nr, nc) == goal:
                    break
    
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = parent[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()
    
    return path if path[0] == start else []

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and grid[start[0]][start[1]] != '#'):
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols and grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] != '#'):
        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    visited = set()
    queue = deque([(start, [start])])
    visited.add(start)

    while queue:
        (row, col), path = queue.popleft()

        neighbors = [(row + 1, col), (row - 1, col), (row, col + 1), (row, col - 1)]

        for neighbor_row, neighbor_col in neighbors:
            if (0 <= neighbor_row < rows and 0 <= neighbor_col < cols and
                grid[neighbor_row][neighbor_col] != '#' and (neighbor_row, neighbor_col) not in visited):
                
                if (neighbor_row, neighbor_col) == goal:
                    return path + [(neighbor_row, neighbor_col)]
                
                visited.add((neighbor_row, neighbor_col))
                queue.append(((neighbor_row, neighbor_col), path + [(neighbor_row, neighbor_col)]))
    
    return []

    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and grid[start[0]][start[1]] != '#'):

        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    queue = [([start], set([start]))]
    
    while queue:
        path, visited = queue.pop(0)
        current = path[-1]
        
        if current == goal:
            return path

        neighbors = [(row - 1, col), (row + 1, col), (row, col - 1), (row, col + 1)]

                new_visited = visited.copy()
                new_visited.add((neighbor_row, neighbor_col))
                queue.append((new_path, new_visited))
    
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check if start or goal is out of bounds or a wall
    if (start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or start_col >= cols or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or goal_col >= cols or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]

    def dfs(current, path_so_far):
        current_row, current_col = current
        visited[current_row][current_col] = True
        if current == (goal_row, goal_col):
            return path_so_far + [current]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            next_row, next_col = current_row + dr, current_col + dc
            if 0 <= next_row < rows and 0 <= next_col < cols:
                if not visited[next_row][next_col] and grid[next_row][next_col] == '.':
                    result = dfs((next_row, next_col), path_so_far + [current])
                    if result is not None:
                        return result
        visited[current_row][current_col] = False
        return None

    result = dfs(start, [])
    return result if result is not None else []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    # Check if start and goal are in the grid
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols) or not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols):
        return []
    # Check start and goal are not walls
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    # If start == goal
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    # Perform DFS
    visited = set()
    path = []
    # Define helper function
    def dfs(current):
        # Add current to visited and path
        visited.add(current)
        path.append(current)
        # Check if current is goal
        if current == goal:
            return path.copy()
        # Explore directions
        directions = [ (-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1) ]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = current[0] + dr
            nc = current[1] + dc
            next_pos = (nr, nc)
            # Check if next_pos is valid and not visited and is a free cell
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_pos not in visited:
                    result = dfs(next_pos)
                    if result is not None:
                        return result
        # Backtrack
        path.pop()
        visited.remove(current)
        return None
    # Call the helper
    result = dfs(start)
    return result if result is not None else []

                visited.add(next_pos)
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    # Check if start or goal is a wall
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    # Heuristic function using Manhattan distance
    def heuristic(pos):
        return abs(pos[0] - goal[0]) + abs(pos[1] - goal[1])

    # Priority queue
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (heuristic(start), start[0], start[1]))
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start[0], start[1]))
    predecessors = {}
    found = False

    # Directions: up, down, left, right
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]

    while heap:
        _, row, col = heapq.heappop(heap)
        current = (row, col)
        if current == goal:
            found = True
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nr, nc))
                    predecessors[(nr, nc)] = current
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (heuristic((nr, nc)), nr, nc))

    if not found:
        return []

    # Reconstruct the path
    path = []
    current = goal
    path.append(current)
    while current != start:
        current = predecessors[current]
        path.append(current)
    path.reverse()
    return path

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    def is_valid(r, c):
        return 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols
    
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    
    if not (is_valid(start_row, start_col) and is_valid(goal_row, goal_col)):
        return []
    
    if grid[start_row][start_col] == '#' or grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#':
        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    import heapq
    import math
    
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0, start_row, start_col))
    
    INF = math.inf
    distances = [[INF] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    distances[start_row][start_col] = 0
    
    previous = [[None] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    found = False
    
    while heap:
        current_dist, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        
        if (r, c) == goal:
            found = True
            break
        
        if current_dist > distances[r][c]:
            continue
        
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_r = r + dr
            new_c = c + dc
            if 0 <= new_r < rows and 0 <= new_c < cols:
                if grid[new_r][new_c] == '.':
                    new_dist = current_dist + 1
                    if new_dist < distances[new_r][new_c]:
                        distances[new_r][new_c] = new_dist
                        previous[new_r][new_c] = (r, c)
                        heapq.heappush(heap, (new_dist, new_r, new_c))
    
    if not found:
        return []
    
    path = []
    current = (r, c)
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        prev = previous[current[0]][current[1]]
        current = prev
    
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check for invalid start or goal positions
    if (not (0 <= start_row < rows and 0 <= start_col < cols) or
        not (0 <= goal_row < rows and 0 <= goal_col < cols)):
        return []
    
    # Check if start or goal is a wall
    if grid[start_row][start_col] == '#' or grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#':
        return []
    
    # If start is the same as goal, return immediately
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    # Heuristic function: Manhattan distance to the goal
    def heuristic(row, col):
        return abs(row - goal_row) + abs(col - goal_col)

    # Priority queue for A* (or greedy best-first search)
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (heuristic(start_row, start_col), start_row, start_col))
    visited = set([(start_row, start_col)])
    parents = {}

    found = False
    while heap:
        _, current_row, current_col = heapq.heappop(heap)
        # Check if current cell is the goal
        if (current_row, current_col) == (goal_row, goal_col):
            found = True
            break
        # Explore neighbors
        directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = current_row + dr, current_col + dc
            if (0 <= new_row < rows and 0 <= new_col < cols and
                grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and (new_row, new_col) not in visited):
                visited.add((new_row, new_col))
                parents[(new_row, new_col)] = (current_row, current_col)
                heapq.heappush(heap, (heuristic(new_row, new_col), new_row, new_col))

    if not found:
        return []

    # Reconstruct path
    path = []
    current = (goal_row, goal_col)
    while current != start:
        path.append(current)
        current = parents[current]
    path.append(start)
    return path[::-1]

                path.append(current)
                current = previous.get(current, None)
            path.reverse()
            return path

            new_row = current_row + dr
            new_col = current_col + dc

            # Check if in bounds

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    if start == goal:
        if (0 <= start_row < rows and 0 <= start_col < cols and
            grid[start_row][start_col] == '.'):
            return [start]
        else:
            return []

    if (start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or start_col >= cols or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or goal_col >= cols or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []

    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]

    def heuristic(pos):
        return abs(pos[0] - goal_row) + abs(pos[1] - goal_col)

    pq = []
    initial_h = heuristic(start)
    heapq.heappush(pq, (initial_h, 0, start))

    came_from = {start: None}
    cost_so_far = {start: 0}
    found = False

    while pq:
        f, g, current = heapq.heappop(pq)
        current_row, current_col = current

        if current == goal:
            found = True
            break

        for dr, dc in directions:
            next_row = current_row + dr
            next_col = current_col + dc

            if 0 <= next_row < rows and 0 <= next_col < cols:
                if grid[next_row][next_col] == '.':
                    next_pos = (next_row, next_col)
                    new_g = g + 1

                    if next_pos not in cost_so_far or new_g < cost_so_far[next_pos]:
                        cost_so_far[next_pos] = new_g
                        h = heuristic(next_pos)
                        f_score = new_g + h
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (f_score, new_g, next_pos))
                        came_from[next_pos] = current

    if not found:
        return []

    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = came_from[current]
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    if grid[start_row][start_col] == '#' or grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]
    heap = []
    initial_h = abs(start_row - goal_row) + abs(start_col - goal_col)
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0 + initial_h, start))
    cost_so_far = { start: 0 }
    parent = {}
    visited = set()
    while heap:
        priority, current = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if current in visited:
            continue
        if current == goal:
            path = []
            while current:
                path.append(current)
                current = parent.get(current, None)
            return path[::-1]
        visited.add(current)
        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = r + dr
            nc = c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                new_g = cost_so_far[current] + 1
                neighbor = (nr, nc)
                if neighbor not in cost_so_far or new_g < cost_so_far[neighbor]:
                    cost_so_far[neighbor] = new_g
                    h = abs(nr - goal_row) + abs(nc - goal_col)
                    new_priority = new_g + h
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_priority, neighbor))
                    parent[neighbor] = current
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    from heapq import heappush, heappop

    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])

    # Check if start or goal is out of bounds or is a wall
    if (start[0] < 0 or start[0] >= rows or start[1] < 0 or start[1] >= cols or
        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal[0] < 0 or goal[0] >= rows or goal[1] < 0 or goal[1] >= cols or
        grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    def heuristic(pos):
        return abs(pos[0] - goal[0]) + abs(pos[1] - goal[1])

    heap = []
    heappush(heap, (heuristic(start), start))
    visited = set()
    predecessors = {}

    while heap:
        _, current = heappop(heap)
        if current in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(current)
        if current == goal:
            # Reconstruct path
            path = []
            curr = current
            while curr != start:
                path.append(curr)
                curr = predecessors[curr]
            path.append(start)
            path.reverse()
            return path
        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            next_pos = (nr, nc)
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and
                next_pos not in visited):
                predecessors[next_pos] = current
                heappush(heap, (heuristic(next_pos), next_pos))

    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        sr, sc = start
        if 0 <= sr < len(grid) and 0 <= sc < len(grid[0]) and grid[sr][sc] == '.':
            return [start]
        else:
            return []
    
    sr, sc = start
    gr, gc = goal
    
    if not (0 <= sr < len(grid)) or not (0 <= sc < len(grid[0])) or grid[sr][sc] == '#':
        return []
    if not (0 <= gr < len(grid)) or not (0 <= gc < len(grid[0])) or grid[gr][gc] == '#':
        return []
    
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    heap = []
    initial_h = abs(sr - gr) + abs(sc - gc)
    heapq.heappush(heap, (initial_h, start, [start]))
    visited = set()
    
    while heap:
        priority, current, path = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if current == goal:
            return path
        if current in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(current)
        cr, cc = current
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
            new_pos = (nr, nc)
            if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and grid[nr][nc] == '.' and new_pos not in visited:
                new_g = len(path)
                new_h = abs(nr - gr) + abs(nc - gc)
                new_priority = new_g + new_h
                new_path = path + [new_pos]
                heapq.heappush(heap, (new_priority, new_pos, new_path))
    
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check if start or goal is out of bounds or a wall
    if (not (0 <= start_row < rows and 0 <= start_col < cols) or
        not (0 <= goal_row < rows and 0 <= goal_col < cols) or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#' or grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    def heuristic(pos):
        return abs(pos[0] - goal_row) + abs(pos[1] - goal_col)

    frontier = []
    heapq.heappush(frontier, (heuristic(start), 0, start))
    came_from = {}
    g_score = {start: 0}
    visited = set()

    while frontier:
        _, current_g, current = heapq.heappop(frontier)
        if current in visited:
            continue
        if current == goal:
            # Reconstruct path
            path = [current]
            while current in came_from:
                current = came_from[current]
                path.insert(0, current)
            return path
        visited.add(current)
        directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            neighbor_row, neighbor_col = current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc
            if (0 <= neighbor_row < rows and 0 <= neighbor_col < cols and
                grid[neighbor_row][neighbor_col] == '.'):
                neighbor = (neighbor_row, neighbor_col)
                tentative_g = current_g + 1
                if neighbor not in g_score or tentative_g < g_score[neighbor]:
                    g_score[neighbor] = tentative_g
                    priority = tentative_g + heuristic(neighbor)
                    heapq.heappush(frontier, (priority, tentative_g, neighbor))
                    came_from[neighbor] = current
    return []

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0

    def is_valid(r, c):
        return 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and grid[r][c] == '.'

    if not (is_valid(*start) and is_valid(*goal)):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [[INF] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    dist[start[0]][start[1]] = 0
    prev = [[None] * cols for _ in range(rows)]

    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0, start[0], start[1]))
    found = False

    while heap:
        current_dist, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            found = True
            break
        if current_dist > dist[r][c]:
            continue
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                new_dist = current_dist + 1
                if new_dist < dist[nr][nc]:
                    dist[nr][nc] = new_dist
                    prev[nr][nc] = (r, c)
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_dist, nr, nc))

    if not found:
        return []

    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()
    return path

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check if start or goal are walls or out of bounds
    if (not (0 <= start_row < rows and 0 <= start_col < cols) or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (not (0 <= goal_row < rows and 0 <= goal_col < cols) or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    INF = float('inf')
    # Initialize distance and predecessor matrices
    distance = [[INF] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    predecessor = [[None] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    distance[start_row][start_col] = 0

    # Directions: up, right, down, left
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]

    # Relax edges repeatedly
    for _ in range(rows * cols):
        updated = False
        for i in range(rows):
            for j in range(cols):
                if grid[i][j] == '#':
                    continue
                current_dist = distance[i][j]
                if current_dist == INF:
                    continue
                for di, dj in directions:
                    ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
                    if 0 <= ni < rows and 0 <= nj < cols and grid[ni][nj] == '.':
                        if distance[ni][nj] > current_dist + 1:
                            distance[ni][nj] = current_dist + 1
                            predecessor[ni][nj] = (i, j)
                            updated = True
        if not updated:
            break

    # Check if goal is reachable
    if distance[goal_row][goal_col] == INF:
        return []

    # Reconstruct path
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = predecessor[current[0]][current[1]]
    if path[-1] != start:
        return []
    path.reverse()
    return path

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    import heapq
    heap = []
    # Start with the initial position and its heuristic value
    initial_heuristic = abs(start[0] - goal[0]) + abs(start[1] - goal[1])
    heapq.heappush(heap, (initial_heuristic, start[0], start[1]))
    visited = set([start])
    parent = {}

    while heap:
        h, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        current = (r, c)
        if current == goal:
            # Reconstruct the path by backtracking through parent pointers
            path = []
            curr = current
            while curr in parent:
                path.append(curr)
                curr = parent[curr]
            path.append(start)
            return path[::-1]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nr, nc))
                    parent[(nr, nc)] = current
                    new_h = abs(nr - goal[0]) + abs(nc - goal[1])
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_h, nr, nc))
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if not rows:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    sr, sc = start
    gr, gc = goal

    # Check if start or goal is a wall
    if (
        grid[sr][sc] == '#' or 
        grid[gr][gc] == '#' or
        not (0 <= sr < rows and 0 <= sc < cols) or
        not (0 <= gr < rows and 0 <= gc < cols)
    ):
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    stack = [(start, [start], {start})]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]  # Up, Right, Down, Left

    while stack:
        (current, path, visited) = stack.pop()
        cr, cc = current
        if current == goal:
            return path
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
            next_cell = (nr, nc)
            if (
                0 <= nr < rows and 
                0 <= nc < cols and 
                grid[nr][nc] == '.' and 
                next_cell not in visited
            ):
                new_visited = visited.copy()
                new_visited.add(next_cell)
                stack.append((next_cell, path + [next_cell], new_visited))
    return []

import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    
    visited = [[False] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = {}
    heap = []
    visited[start[0]][start[1]] = True
    
    # Add the start node to the heap with a random priority
    heapq.heappush(heap, (random.random(), start[0], start[1]))
    
    while heap:
        _, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        
        if (r, c) == goal:
            # Reconstruct the path from goal to start using parent pointers
            path = []
            curr = (r, c)
            while curr:
                path.append(curr)
                curr = parent.get(curr)
            return path[::-1]
        
        # Attempt to move in all four orthogonal directions
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if not visited[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                    visited[nr][nc] = True
                    parent[(nr, nc)] = (r, c)
                    # Push the new node onto the heap with a random priority
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (random.random(), nr, nc))
    
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    s_row, s_col = start
    g_row, g_col = goal
    
    if (s_row < 0 or s_row >= rows or s_col < 0 or s_col >= cols or 
        grid[s_row][s_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (g_row < 0 or g_row >= rows or g_col < 0 or g_col >= cols or 
        grid[g_row][g_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    # Bellman-Ford algorithm
    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [[INF]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    dist[s_row][s_col] = 0
    
    for _ in range(rows * cols - 1):
        updated = False
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(cols):
                if grid[r][c] == '#':
                    continue
                current_dist = dist[r][c]
                for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                        if dist[nr][nc] > current_dist + 1:
                            dist[nr][nc] = current_dist + 1
                            updated = True
        if not updated:
            break
    
    if dist[g_row][g_col] == INF:
        return []
    
    # Reconstruct path
    path = []
    current = (g_row, g_col)
    path.append(current)
    while current != (s_row, s_col):
        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and 
                grid[nr][nc] == '.' and dist[nr][nc] == dist[r][c] - 1):
                current = (nr, nc)
                path.append(current)
                break
    path.reverse()
    return path

    if start == goal:
        return [start] if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.' else []
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    import heapq
    heap = []
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    start_row, start_col = start
    initial_h = abs(start_row - goal_row) + abs(start_col - goal_col)
    heapq.heappush(heap, (initial_h, start_row, start_col))
    visited = set([(start_row, start_col)])
    parents = {}

    while heap:
        h, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if (r, c) == goal:

                    parents[(nr, nc)] = (r, c)
                    new_h = abs(nr - goal_row) + abs(nc - goal_col)
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_h, nr, nc))

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal

    # Check if start or goal is a wall or out of bounds
    if (start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or start_col >= cols or
        grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if (goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or goal_col >= cols or
        grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    INF = float('inf')
    distance = [[INF] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    predecessor = [[None] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    distance[start_row][start_col] = 0

    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]  # up, down, left, right

    # Bellman-Ford algorithm to find shortest path
    for _ in range(rows * cols - 1):
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(cols):
                if distance[r][c] == INF:
                    continue
                for dr, dc in directions:
                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                        if distance[nr][nc] > distance[r][c] + 1:
                            distance[nr][nc] = distance[r][c] + 1
                            predecessor[nr][nc] = (r, c)

    # Check if goal is unreachable
    if distance[goal_row][goal_col] == INF:
        return []

    # Reconstruct path
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = predecessor[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()

    # Validate path starts at start
    if path[0] != start:
        return []
    return path

import heapq
import math

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (0, start[0], start[1]))
    distances = [[math.inf for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    distances[start[0]][start[1]] = 0
    predecessors = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    while pq:
        curr_dist, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            path = []
            curr = (r, c)
            while curr is not None:
                path.append(curr)
                curr = predecessors[curr[0]][curr[1]]
            return path[::-1]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = r + dr
            nc = c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] != '#':
                new_dist = curr_dist + 1
                if new_dist < distances[nr][nc]:
                    distances[nr][nc] = new_dist
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (new_dist, nr, nc))
                    predecessors[nr][nc] = (r, c)

def solve(grid, start, goal):

        grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#'):
